items.headline: Anthropic shares jump 21% after $107.3 billion IPO breaks record
items.summary: Anthropic PBC shares soared 21% above their IPO price after the artificial intelligence lab’s blockbuster $107.3 billion debut broke SpaceX’s record for the biggest-ever offering.

items.headline: AMD dives on short seller report of alleged China exposure
items.summary: AMD closed down over 7% after a short seller alleged that its firmware showed up at a blacklisted Chinese company. AMD said it complies with U.S. law.

items.headline: California attorney general issues Nvidia subpoena in probe of China chip diversion
items.summary: The investigation by California Attorney General Rob Bonta comes on the heels of the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

items.headline: Congress passes bill to protect older investors from financial fraud
items.summary: Both chambers of Congress have now approved the Financial Exploitation Prevention Act of 2025, which is aimed at protecting vulnerable investors from fraud.

items.headline: Japan core inflation soars to highest this year as energy subsidy expiry pushes up consumer prices
items.summary: The core inflation figure — which strips out prices of food — was lower than the 2.3% expected by Reuters-polled economists.

items.headline: S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow End Lower As Anthropic Trading Debut Fails To Provide Adequate Confidence —  ANT, META, AAPL, GME In Focus
items.summary: Anthropic closed its debut trading session 17% higher from its listing price of $83 a share.

items.headline: Anthropic was supposed to save the AI trade. What went wrong?
items.summary: Technology stocks tanked despite one of the most hotly anticipated tech IPOs in years. Why Anthropic couldn't revive AI animal spirits.

items.headline: SoftBank plunges over 16% as AI sell-off hits Asian tech stocks following Anthropic debut
items.summary: SoftBank shares plunged over 16% on Friday as Japanese and South Korean technology stocks fell sharply.

items.headline: Billionaire Stanley Druckenmiller issues blunt warning on stocks and Fed rate hikes
items.summary: The warning came after a quiet shift.

items.headline: Citigroup misbooked trades at European unit, underestimated risk by $35 bln, Reuters reports
General Motors steps back from EVs, announces hundreds of fresh layoffs
items.summary: The Detroit automaker is preparing another round of layoffs, extending uncertainty for workers already affected by earlier cuts.

items.headline: Commerce approved sales of more than 879,000 AI chips to Chinese companies, Rep. Mast says
items.summary: Members of Congress have pushed in the wake of the Jensen Huang scandal for legislation to tighten export controls on chip sales to China.

items.headline: Anthropic's historic debut to put AI's promise and peril on Wall Street trial
items.summary: The strong demand for Anthropic shares amid a broader tech selloff offers hope to a sectorwhere euphoria has somewhat cooled in recent weeks.

items.headline: Anthropic IPO: Investors who flip the stock may face brokerage penalty
items.summary: Brokerage firms may put future IPO limits in place for investors who sell their Anthropic stake too soon.

items.headline: UniCredit S.p.A. (UNCRY) Presents at J.P. Morgan European Financials Conference Transcript
Intuit to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for $3.68 billion
items.summary: Intuit is offloading a segment that has slowed down revenue growth, for less than a third of what it paid to acquire Mailchimp in 2021.

items.headline: Palo Alto stock jumps on earnings beat and company's big bet on securing open-weight models
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks reported better-than-expected first-quarter results and inked a $4.5 billion deal for AI startup Applied Compute

items.headline: Amazon app warns New York of higher costs if Mamdani delivery law passes
items.summary: Amazon has lobbied heavily against the proposed legislation, while New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani backed the bill earlier this year.

items.headline: Kraken parent's acquisition of Tribe Capital flags new chapter in evolution of crypto exchanges
items.summary: Payward, the owner of crypto exchange Kraken, is pushing into private markets with its purchase of venture capital and asset management provider Tribe Capital.

items.headline: S&P 500 heads for 6th straight decline. Plus, J&J advances two key products
items.summary: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.
